description: This source file implements a Tuner class within the Thunder::Broadcast namespace, providing functionality for DVB frontend tuning, filtering, and status monitoring on Linux systems. It includes DVB API interactions, tuner configuration, and section filtering mechanisms.

classes.name: Tuner
classes.description: Implements DVB frontend tuner operations, including tuning, status monitoring, and section filtering.

classes.name: Tuner::Information
classes.description: Holds configuration and status information about the tuner, including supported standards and modes.

classes.name: Tuner::Observer
classes.description: A thread class that monitors tuner status and manages registered tuner callbacks.

classes.name: Tuner::MuxFilter
classes.description: Handles filtering of MPEG sections via Linux DVB demux device, managing buffer and read operations.

classes.name: Tuner::Config
classes.description: JSON configuration container for tuner settings such as frontends, standard, annex, and scan options.

methods.name: Tuner::Create
methods.description: Creates a new Tuner instance based on configuration string.

methods.name: Tuner::Properties
methods.description: Returns tuner properties such as support for auto FEC and second-generation support.

methods.name: Tuner::Tune
methods.description: Configures the tuner to lock onto a specific frequency, modulation, symbol rate, FEC, and inversion.

methods.name: Tuner::Filter
methods.description: Sets up a filter for specific PSI/SI tables and PIDs, with callback handling.

methods.name: Tuner::Dispatch
methods.description: Checks frontend status and updates tuner state accordingly.
